description.value: Indian Curry King is a takeout-only Indian restaurant located inside an Esso gas station on Canyon Street in Creston. The menu is extensive, spanning classic curries, biryanis, street food, and fusion items like butter chicken pizza and poutine. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian diners are well served, making it a practical and flavourful fuel stop for cyclists passing through the Creston Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active with a full online ordering system, confirming the business is open. The website confirms takeout/pickup service and a vegetarian main course section plus a menu legend listing vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Two concerns noted: the phone number on the website (+1 (250) 254-0801) differs from OSM (+1-250-428-4403), and the postal code on the website (V0B1G0) differs slightly from OSM (V0B 1G5); the website values are treated as more current per Rule 12.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-428-4403 but website lists +1 (250) 254-0801. Website value used as likely more current.
Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V0B 1G5, website footer shows V0B1G0. Minor but flagged for verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible takeout restaurant with an active website and online ordering. Convenient location inside a gas station on a main road through Creston makes it a practical stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu has a dedicated 'Vegetarian Main Course' section (Dal Makhni, Palak Paneer, Chickpea Curry, etc.) and the menu legend explicitly lists vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free indicators
